reason: Text color=success and the success Badge use the state fill (green 500) as ink: 2.3:1 on white, 2.1:1 on its tint. The design system has no darker text variant yet.
Text color=warning and the warning Badge use the state fill (amber 500) as ink: 1.9:1 on white, 1.8:1 on its tint. The design system has no darker text variant yet.
color=faint mixes the muted ink 55% with transparent: 2.3:1 on white.
text.tone=success uses the state fill as ink: 2.3:1 on white.
The success callout title uses the state fill as ink on its own tint: 2.1:1.
The completed-step check mark uses the success fill on a tinted disc: 1.9:1.
The declarative input placeholder uses label-caption (173,178,184): 2.1:1 on white. The Whale UI input uses label-tertiary (3.7:1).
